package.name: Finco1 Validation Evidence Matrix
package.base_sha_note: B15 refresh base. Reflects current PR base after the B15 governance refresh, which incorporates the Phase 51N checkpoint (post-M2 route extraction checkpoint + Agent B docs integration + Claude review preparation pack). The matrix will become stale on the next rebase and is maintained as a snapshot, not as a live reference. For the live base, see origin/main.

claim_level_definitions.external_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the project is willing to make a written statement to an outside party that the area behaves as documented. NOT a lender/bank/audit/regulatory/certification/SaaS claim.
claim_level_definitions.pilot_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the area is ready for controlled-pilot exposure to a real human user. NOT a production claim.

post_phase_51n_route_extraction_state.summary: After Phase 51N, Agent A has reached the post-M2 route extraction checkpoint. 12 service-backed routes and 13 service modules are in place; 5 inline hotspots remain (tracked in B17).

claude_review_status.rationale: Claude review is handled separately outside the B-track governance pack. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack, but Claude review itself is not represented in this B-track branch as completed. A Claude review result, when provided by the user, will be reflected in B16 (External Review Closeout Tracker) only — and only as a separate workstream, never as a side-effect of B15.

global_notes: No area in this matrix currently has external_claim_allowed: true. The project does not make external claims at this time.
Areas with pilot_claim_allowed: true are candidates for the controlled pilot (B7). They are not yet ready for any external claim.
AREA-001 (TUHO) and AREA-002 (Oborovo) are the two narrow-scope targets for promotion to approved_for_narrow_scope after B1 review and a controlled pilot.
AREA-003 (generic solar) and AREA-004 (generic wind) are explicitly exploratory and are not promoted to pilot or external claim by the existence of Oborovo / TUHO as specific projects.
AREA-007 (Tax) is too broad for a blanket pilot claim; sub-area decomposition (CIT, LCF, ATAD, WHT, depreciation, cash-tax timing) is required before any tax sub-area enters pilot scope.
AREA-013 (scenario persistence) and AREA-015 (Phase 51G-1) reflect pre-51G-2 behavior; pin refresh and forward-compatibility decision are pending after 51G-2 through 51M-2.
AREA-014 (Phase 51F guardrails) is regression protection, not external validation, and is not promoted to external_claim_allowed by being green. It is also not a user-facing pilot feature.
AREA-015 (Phase 51G-1) is characterization only; it is superseded for production surface area by Phase 51G-2/51G-3/51H-1 (see AREA-019).

AREA-016 (B1 external review package) is documentation and evidence preparation, not external validation. The package is in place; no third-party review has been performed. B16 closeout tracker reflects this.
AREA-019 covers Phase 51G-2 through 51N. All are Agent A owned and not modified by this PR. 5 inline hotspots remain (B17).
AREA-020 (Phase 51N) was added in B15 to track the 51N checkpoint from a B-track governance perspective. It does not claim Claude has approved anything.

Claude review is separate. The B-track governance pack does not represent Claude review as completed. Claude review is handled outside this branch; the B16 External Review Closeout Tracker will reflect the result, when provided, as a separate workstream.
This matrix is a working artifact. Demotions to weaker categories are encouraged when evidence is found insufficient. See model_evidence_taxonomy.md §6 for the demotion procedure.
